title: AI-Learn：AI学习资源合集
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了AI学习资源，涵盖Python、数学、机器学习、深度学习、神经网络、LLM、RAG、提示词、Agent及AIOS等内容，适合作为系统学习AI的知识索引。
summary_en: This GitHub repository collects AI learning resources covering Python, mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, LLM, RAG, prompts, agents, AIOS, and papers, serving as a knowledge index for systematic AI study.
